reference_application.name: Obsidian
reference_application.inspection: Read-only macOS accessibility and screenshot inspection of the user-opened reference window.

reference_layout.titlebar: native traffic lights with compact navigation controls and sidebar toggle affordances

workflow: Opened the fixture through the native open-directory picker.
Opened Welcome.md from the vault file pane.
Verified the note tab, source editor, outline and backlinks panes in the visible window.
Verified the integrated titlebar navigation accessibility tree, hid and restored the left sidebar, and hid and restored the right context sidebar.

openobsidian_layout.native_traffic_lights: visible through Electron hiddenInset titlebar styling

implementation: Added a compact Obsidian-like three-column shell with vertical ribbon, file pane and split workspace.
Added compact chrome, tab strip, vault identity footer and accessible ribbon proxies for core commands.
Kept the right context pane visible in the initial empty state so the starting geometry matches the reference split layout.
Added a structural layout validator and included it in the quality gate.
Fixed the sandboxed Electron preload to ship as dist/preload.cjs so the visible Open vault flow reaches the main process.
Integrated the native macOS traffic lights with a compact titlebar navigation band and working left/right sidebar toggles.
Moved theme metrics, semantic workspace actions and workspace block descriptors into the platform-neutral src/shared/ui contract for future Expo reuse.

assessment.basis: The major reference regions and rounded dimensions match in the visible macOS comparison; this is a first-pass shell assessment, not a pixel-diff claim.
assessment.remaining_scope: Reference theme/snippet behavior, graph/canvas rendering, popouts, cross-platform checks, screen-reader traces and full workflow certification remain pending.
